items.title: Coherent (COHR) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift As AI Demand Shapes Analyst Views
items.summary: Coherent’s modeled fair value has shifted from about US$394.62 to about US$415.36, marking a modest reset in where analysts see the stock’s price target range. This adjustment sits against a backdrop of intense focus on AI driven transceiver demand, data center visibility, and the potential impact of sold out capacity and upcoming product launches on future revenue and earnings.
